intro.title: Simple Todo List
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple todo list application where you can add, view, and remove tasks. You will learn how to manage a list of items using Vue's reactive state and handle user interactions with event handlers. The main technologies involved are Vue components, the `ref` function for state, and event binding with `v-on` or `@`. This project will help you understand the basics of dynamic data and user input in Vue.
intro.usecase: Todo lists are foundational UI patterns that appear in countless real-world applications beyond simple task managers. Developers implement similar list management interfaces for e-commerce shopping carts, project management dashboards (like Trello cards), and content moderation queues where items can be added, marked complete, or removed. Understanding this pattern is essential for building interactive features like notification centers, user preference checklists, or admin panels where dynamic item management is required. Mastering todo list implementation provides the core skills for handling user-generated lists in applications ranging from personal productivity tools to enterprise software.
